AURORA-X Mk-I Surveillance Radar - Specification

The AURORA-X Mk-I is a fictional S-band 3D surveillance radar.

Frequency band: S-band, 2.9 to 3.3 GHz.
Total system mass: 12 tonnes.
Prime power consumption: 85 kW.

Developed by the Synthetic Radar Laboratory (SRL), Bengaluru.

AURORA-X Mk-I Trial Report, November 2024

Trial report for the fictional AURORA-X Mk-I radar, conducted November 2024 at the Synthetic Test Range, Chandipur.
Measured maximum detection range against a fighter-size target: 430 km, which is 20 km below the specification value.
The shortfall was attributed to atmospheric ducting during the trial window.
No trial of the AURORA-XB variant has been conducted.
